LearnLingo

Give Moodle a friendly, progress-focused experience while keeping its familiar learning features.

LearnLingo brings a playful presentation to the homepage, learner dashboard, course views and login screen. Institutions can adapt colors, imagery and layouts without changing how Moodle activities, enrolments or grading work.

A coherent site identity
  • Brand colors, site logo and favicon.
  • Homepage, dashboard and course presentation.
  • Login experience and custom footer.
  • Exportable and importable branding settings.
Flexible homepage
Choose a learning-focused homepage, Moodle's standard front page or custom content to suit the institution's public entrance.
Course and dashboard presentation
Decide which visual elements, introductory sections and progress details appear for learners, rather than duplicating information.
ChatGPT and Claude customization
With the optional Moodle MCP connection, administrators can review and update supported theme content through an assistant.
A visual identity that reaches beyond the homepage

A site is more than its landing page. LearnLingo helps administrators maintain the same visual language across the dashboard, courses, login and footer, while keeping the options to make each area appropriate for its job.

Branding configurations can be exported and imported for reuse. Administrators should still review readability, contrast, responsive behavior and a representative course after major visual changes.

Optional assistant integration: connect Moodle to ChatGPT or Claude through the Moodle MCP plugin. Supported changes are permission-controlled and require explicit confirmation; LearnLingo also works without this integration.
